artworks.title: Conversion of Paul
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.9 × 8.3 cm (2 11/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a busy biblical scene. The scene features numerous figures in motion, some on horseback, within a cityscape backdrop. The atmosphere is dynamic with figures wielding weapons and banners. The sky is filled with expressive clouds and rays, creating dramatic tension. The drawing effectively captures intensity and movement through intricate detailing and lines.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. In the center, a figure is depicted on a cross with a crown of thorns and an inscription above. Flanking the crucifix, there are several figures in detailed garments, arranged in various poses. The background features a landscape with architectural elements, including a small town or village and rolling hills. The scene is rendered with fine lines and textures, capturing details of facial expressions and cloth folds, with a balanced composition conveying a depth of emotion through the figures' body language and expressions.

artworks.title: King Ferdinand of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a side profile facing left. The individual has pronounced facial features with a prominent nose, beard, and mustache. They are wearing an elaborate headpiece that resembles a combination of a cap and a turban. The clothing includes a draped garment covering the shoulders and chest. The person is holding an ornamental object resembling a scepter. The background includes a decorative arch with swirling cloud-like patterns, and two heraldic shields in the upper corners. The date "1547" is inscribed in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Armed Three-Master with Daedalus and Icarus in the Sky
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a nautical scene with a sailing ship on choppy waters. The horizon is high with landmasses and cliffs on the left side. Details show the ship's sails and rigging. The color palette is monochrome with sepia and gray tones. The scene is illuminated by a bright sun. Figures of Icarus and Daedalus are in the sky. A smaller boat is visible in the distance. Waves surround the ship's hull, creating a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Armed Three-Master on the Open Sea, Accompanied by a Galley
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a ship with its sails unfurled, positioned centrally. The horizon, featuring a calm sea and sky, is visible behind the ship. The ship's rigging, masts, sails, and woodwork are detailed using an etching technique. The color palette is primarily black, white, and gray. Light, streaky clouds fill the sky, adding depth to the scene. The water shows dynamic waves in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Triumph of the Virgin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 56 × 37.5 cm (22 1/16 × 14 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession with symbolic figures and iconography. The scene is celestial, showing a central figure in a chariot with other figures around. Angels and cherubs are in the sky, surrounded by clouds and banners. Below, figures in robes form a circular formation. A dragon-like creature and classical architectural elements are visible in the background. The drawing is detailed, highlighting movement, symbolism, and exultation.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin
artworks.artist: Juste Chevillet after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a half-body portrait of an older man facing slightly to his left and looking at the viewer. He wears round spectacles, a headscarf, a coat, and a neckerchief. The man's expression is neutral. He is not holding any objects and wears no visible jewelry. The background is a dark, plain surface and the portrait is surrounded by an ornate border with floral and column motifs.

artworks.title: La Gouvernante
artworks.artist: Bernard Lépicié after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The print shows two individuals, an adult woman and a child, in an indoor setting. The woman is sitting on a chair, leaning slightly forward, looking at the child on the right. She is wearing a wide dress with a white apron, and her hair is tucked into a white cap. She has a neutral expression, and her hands are in her lap, holding a black tricorn hat in one hand and a wide brush in the other hand. The child is standing in front of the woman, holding a bundle of books under their arm. They have long dark hair tied with a ribbon and wear a knee-length dress with large buttons. They have their hands clasped in front of them and are looking down at the ground. The room has a simple background, with wooden flooring and a plain wall with a partially open door behind the child. On the right side, the edge of a desk is visible. On the floor in front of the people, there is a racket and a shuttlecock, playing cards, and an open basket.

artworks.title: La Maitresse d'ecole
artworks.artist: Bernard Lépicié after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals engaging in a learning activity. An adult woman is visible, leaning slightly forward and demonstrating something with a writing tool on a slate or piece of paper. She wears a fabric head covering and modest clothing. Beside her, a young child is behind a wooden desk or counter, holding the other end of the slate or paper and looking intently at it. The background is plain, with French text at the bottom identifying the scene as "LA MAITRESSE D'ECOLE."

artworks.title: La Mere laborieuse
artworks.artist: Bernard Lépicié after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, a woman and a young girl, next to a spinning wheel. The woman is seated on a chair, sewing, while the girl stands beside her. A small dog rests nearby on a wooden surface. Other household items, like a teapot and a candelabra, are visible.

artworks.title: Monsieur, pardon si je vous gêne un peu...
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals seated at a long table covered with books and papers. Each person's body is visible from the waist up, as they are positioned sitting at the table, engaged in reading or looking at books. The first person on the left appears to be resting their head on their hand, showing a profile view with short, dark hair. The central figure has an exaggeratedly large nose and chin, with a turban-like headwear covering most of the hair. They are holding a pen and seem to be writing or drawing. To the right, a person with thinning hair is glancing over some stacked books, with eyes wide open, and another individual's face is partially visible peeking over one of the stacks. The individuals are surrounded by numerous large books and some small writing instruments. Behind them is a large bookcase filled with neatly arranged books, and a wooden ladder rests against the bookcase.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Giaour and the Pasha (Combat du Giaour et du Pacha)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an equestrian scene. The scene features a rearing horse with a rider, as well as a figure lying on the ground. The background includes mountains and other horses. At the bottom of the drawing, there are sketches of a horse head, hooves, and a head in profile view, likely preparatory drawings. The artwork conveys motion and tension through precise shading and expressive line work.

artworks.title: The Holy Family on a Grassy Bench
artworks.description: The image features various figures in a scene. In the center, a woman holds an infant on her lap. The woman is depicted in a frontal position with a serene expression. She is adorned in a textured robe and has a halo above her head. To her right, an older woman holds a basket of fruit. Another woman is on the left, partially obscured. A child is seated in the foreground, and the background includes clouds and textured terrain.

artworks.title: Two Men Arguing
artworks.description: The sketch shows two people depicted in full body from behind and in a three-quarter view. The person on the left is standing with their back to the viewer, with a head turned slightly to the side. They have long, wavy hair and are wearing a coat. The other person is facing forward with their body slightly turned toward the first person. They have short hair and are wearing a jacket over an inner garment. This person is holding a hat in one hand. The scene is set against a plain background with some shading to suggest depth.

artworks.title: Foreshore Scene with Windmill
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The riverside scene is depicted from a slightly elevated perspective. A windmill stands prominently near the center. The horizon is high in the composition, where the river meets the sky with a line of clouds. The sketch has delicate pencil strokes giving a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic with tones of grey and beige. Small boats float on the river, with figures engaged in activities. In the distance, more boats and structures are suggested against the horizon line.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in buff, light brown, light violet gray, and dark gray
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered near a riverside landscape. The image shows individuals dressed in flowing garments around an infant on a small stone altar. Some figures gesture towards the baby, while others look on. The background features a cityscape, a bridge, and a large, leafy tree dominating the right side. The drawing is in monochromatic sepia tones, giving it an antique appearance. The detailing in the clothing and the organic forms of the trees contrast with the structured city in the background.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [left plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people beneath an architectural structure with arches. It features several individuals in period clothing standing under the arches. Some figures appear engaged in an exchange, while others are arranged in a line. In the background, there are cliffs and sparse vegetation. The style resembles traditional etching or lithography techniques.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [center plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people standing on the steps of a classical building. The scene shows figures gathered on a set of stairs leading to a large architectural structure with ornate features, such as columns with elaborate capitals. The building has multiple levels with balconies where additional figures are observing the scene below. In the foreground, an assortment of individuals are arranged with expressions of engagement and interaction. Detailed lines are used to convey folds in clothing and the texture of architectural elements. The background includes a partial landscape with hints of trees. The drawing is rendered in a highly detailed and classical style reminiscent of Renaissance or early Baroque works.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [right plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This drawing features classical architecture and figures on stairs. The scene shows various figures descending a staircase adorned with columns. One figure stands at the top with raised hands, while another in elaborate drapery is among them. At the base of the stairs is a basket of goods, and beneath the staircase is a heraldic emblem with the inscription 'DUCTI AMOR PATRIAE'. The figures and architectural details are depicted in fine line work, resembling engraving or etching.

artworks.title: The Virgin in Clouds and Six Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of line block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of religious figures in a celestial setting. The illustration shows a composition divided into two main sections. In the upper section, there is a depiction of a holy scene with a central figure holding a child, surrounded by cherubs, all set amidst an array of clouds. Above them, an eagle is featured, emanating rays of light. In the lower section, several figures in ornate robes and religious attire are gathered, one holding a book and another a large staff. The style is characterized by intricate detailing and classical motifs often associated with religious iconography, with the artist rendering figures and drapery with precision and depth. The effect is that of a divine assembly mirroring traditional religious tableaux.

artworks.title: The Death of Saint Peter Martyr
artworks.description: This drawing depicts multiple figures in a forest setting. An angelic figure hovers at the top with wings outstretched. The forest below is filled with intricately detailed trees. Figures on the ground are in dynamic poses, one showing surprise or fear, and another reaching upwards. The composition is detailed with flowing garments and textured foliage, evoking tension and animation.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple (The Circumcision)
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people assembled under an ornate, classical-style archway. The scene features figures dressed in flowing robes, gathered in a space defined by an architectural structure that includes columns and a large decorative arch adorned with rich patterns and sculptural elements. Above the group, an archway displays intricate detailing, including patterns and depictions of figures who appear to be gesticulating or interacting symbolically with the scene below. The texture of the robes and other elements is conveyed using fine lines and cross-hatching, suggesting a detailed and expressive style, depicting a dramatic or religious narrative.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a natural setting under a canopy of large trees. The individuals are standing or sitting, interacting with each other. The central figure is seated on a slightly elevated surface, wearing elaborate clothing and jewelry. Other people around them are dressed in flowing garments, possibly tunics or robes, engaged in various activities. One figure is leaning forward with a baby in a basket, while others observe. The background shows a natural setting with an architectural structure on the left side. The illustration is monochrome with intricate shading and details.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a central figure surrounded by angelic figures. The main figure is sitting in the center, with other figures around them, some of whom have wings. They are interacting with a newborn in a tender atmosphere. Above, there are cherubs or angelic faces with wings surrounding the scene, and one figure flying downwards towards the characters below. The drawing is detailed, with attention to drapery, posture, and expression, conveying a sense of divine celebration or religious significance.
